body:
OMG, the getaway car bridge 🚗

the whole thing came together in under 30 seconds. taylor and jack antonoff in the studio, and the only reason anyone ever got to see it is that her iPhone happened to be on.

jack has called that clip one of a kind in his career: "the only time in my life...that a camera was ever on when magic actually happened."

he thinks that's exactly why the video took off. because it was real. one of reputation's biggest moments, arriving in real time, on a phone propped up in the room.

send this to the friend who screams the bridge every single time.
